commenti.body: If you’re into Ken Russell, you’ll probably dig it. Definitely doesn’t deserve its status as a turkey — it fits right in with a lot of his 70s work. Its critical and financial failure made it hard for him to get work for a few years afterwards and then he ended up stumbling into Altered States. If you have a region free (or B) player, there’s a blu-ray out from BFI that I recommend. Absolutely worth a watch!
